title: Ambient Section Particles
concept: R/V Calder, a fictional deep-sea research vessel on a marine-snow transect: a canvas layer of slowly sinking snow aggregates and rare bioluminescent motes behind the hero (with a quiet reading zone, gentle pointer wash and a 'Pulse the thrusters' gust control), and a second bounded layer where the snow settles into a height-capped seafloor bed.
notes: Canvas 2D, one rAF loop per section, density from section area (clamped, lower on mobile/low-core devices), DPR capped at 2, IntersectionObserver + visibilitychange pausing, ResizeObserver resizes without respawning. Reduced motion renders a sparse seeded still with no loop. The light 'vessel' section between them is deliberately particle-free.
